notes.title: Happy Easter festival, Clocker Major Update is ready now!
notes.content:
Welcome both our new and old friends, happy Easter festival!

So finally, Clocker major update is ready now, with a limited-time sale up to 30% off!

I’ve already been overwhelmed by your feedback I’ve received from the players' community, we've added many in-game hints to help to solve the puzzles much easily! There's also a new mini-game to get the clues.

So when is the best time to add Clocker to your steam library? RIGHT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916050/Clocker/

notes.title: Game hotfix - V1.1.3 (September 7th)
notes.content:
Update:
1.Fixed a startup black screen problem caused by archiving formats.
2.Changed the background of "Highway Blossoms", "What happened in the village".
3.Added auxiliary lines in normal level editor.

There are currently two possibilities to start a black screen
1.Win10 users start the game without full screen, which caused by engine compatibility.
To fix it, you can try full screen startup or set quality to fastest

2.Win7 users cannot load the archive properly because of the archive format.
You can open the original archive in Notepad and save in UTF8 format. If there is not much archive content, you can delete the archive and start the game

notes.title: Game hotfix - V1.1.2 (August 26th)
notes.content:
August 25th Update
1.New jigsaw "Highway Blossoms"
2.Add three high difficulty modes (one color level) in Random mode  
3.Adjust some levels condition according to statistics
4.Players could set the difficulty in level editor now, workshop description will show difficulty
5.Jigsaw editor adds auxiliary lines, background grid and Background color adjustment (auxiliary drawing, not actual color)
6. Upload feature has been changed to OFF by default
7.The editor “Load Png” will automatically select the last picture for making it easier to adjust the tolerance
8.Added an option to hide crown rules

August 26th Update
1.Added three levels come from players
2.Added Normal / Jigsaw tags in the workshop description (Only works for new items after this update)

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list][*]Jigsaw level editor
[*]There are 56 default colors in level editor now, changed from 32（Remind: you could double-click any color to open the palette）
[*]The music button (Default key: P) in level editor has been replaced, now you could use the new button (Default key: M) to move the painting board. This new feature may create key confliction issues, please change the key settings if occurs.[/list]

[h1]Known BUG[/h1]
Player's workshop could only shows 50 items when you've subscribed more than 50 items. This bug will be fixed in next update.

[h1]Coming update in this week[/h1]
[list][*]Add 5 new levels
[*]Adjust some levels' diffculty
[*]Add Turkish language
[*]Adjust some English translation
[*]Collect statistics to calculate the averge play time of first run of each run. We will keep adjusting difficulty depend on this.
[*]Fix the workshop BUG mentioned above[/list]

[h1]Future plan[/h1]
[list][*]Player could visit steam workshop item inside the game without opening browser
[*]Keep polishing jigsaw level editor
[*]Keep adding features to normal level editor
[*]Keep polishing depend on community's feedback[/list]

notes.title: Game hotfix - V1.0.2 (August 8th)
notes.content:
Update
1. Add ten 25x25 levels come from player.
2. The "book" level has been updated,  fixed a visual issue caused by similar color.
3. In the editor, add the shortcut key "S" to quick save
4. Fixed the default shortcut key BUG and adjust them to similar to Photoshop. Due to this update, all players' current key setting has been restored to its default status.
5.According to community feedback, the time limit of Jigsaw puzzles has been changed from 4 minutes to 6 minutes, the cancel limit has been changed from 5 times to 8 times.
6.Now Draw Puzzle will create a local save data for emergency recovery
